description: Main window. Two notes. (1) sql:allow-execute is listed separately on purpose — sql:default is only [allow-close, allow-load, allow-select], so without it every INSERT/UPDATE/CREATE from JS is rejected while reads keep working, which presents as a schema bug rather than a permissions one. (2) The http scope below is the OS-level twin of src/core/net/allowlist.ts: even if the TypeScript allowlist were deleted, the Rust side would still refuse to fetch any host not named here (constraint 1).
